principle: Regulatory Graph is source-neutral and jurisdiction-aware. Product Twin never treats a marketplace listing as proof of legal suitability.

jurisdiction_model.inheritance: Rules cascade from broader jurisdictions unless superseded or narrowed by a more specific rule.

decision_states.PASS: Known evidence indicates the item/system satisfies this rule for the proposed use.
decision_states.BLOCK: Known evidence indicates it must not be specified/procured/installed for this use.
decision_states.HOLD: Required evidence is missing or stale; professional review or documentation is required.
decision_states.REVIEW: Rule is context-dependent and requires project professional/authority confirmation.
decision_states.OPPORTUNITY: Not mandatory; an incentive, efficiency improvement or preferred-compliance option exists.
decision_states.NOT_APPLICABLE: Rule does not apply to this product/system/use.

procurement_gate.rule: No Product Twin is marked legally suitable solely because it is purchasable or ships to the project region.
